verdict.rationale: W&B has an official CLI documented at docs.wandb.ai/models/ref/cli, but this is a general W&B (Models) CLI reference rather than a Weave-specific CLI, and the evidence pack does not detail Weave-specific CLI commands or subcommands. Missing for 10: dedicated Weave CLI documentation, examples of Weave-specific CLI usage (e.g., trace/eval management via CLI), and independent confirmation of its scope/maturity for Weave workflows.
